title: 第六章 基地（下）
content_zh:
时间在太阳的西移中，慢慢的流失。这个吸血鬼的城市在沙漠绿洲里静静的睡着，白天的安静，似乎在期待着黑夜的精彩。

    而下一个夜晚注定会不同于以往。

    艾妮尔一直趴在桌上睡着，她本来就习惯于白天睡觉，加上这次远途的疲惫，对萨尔的安心，她睡的很沉，沉到不知道什么时候萨尔离开了，什么时候太阳落山了，什么时候黑暗笼罩着城市的每一寸，地下，屋中，开始有了灯光与人影。

    艾妮尔被屋内的一些脚步声惊醒，抬头看着已经将自己围起来的陌生同类，她揉了揉眼睛，“你们是谁？”

    “小姐你是谁？为什么会在这里？”其中一位年青英俊的男子，正撑着下腭好奇的打量着她。

    “为什么要告诉你！”艾妮尔很清楚对方是什么人，除了吸血鬼的身份之外，还是敌人，只是现在她要表现的像个初来者，逃离来的求生者。

    “你可以不说，那么你的朋友……”对方笑着，无情的目光中带着嬉戏的趣味，“可能就要离开你了。”

    顺着他的手指，艾妮尔看到了艾勒维格他们，还有架在他们脖子上的刀刃，正闪着寒光。

    “Z！救……”多力一急，挣扎着喊道。

    “随便！”说着，艾妮尔打了个哈欠，转身看了看门外，“原来天已经黑了！看来我可以走了。”

    “Z！你怎么可以……”听到这样的答案，多力愣了半响，才责问道。

    “为什么不可以！你们给我做事，我付你们钱，现在事干不了，那么各走各的，难道你想着我会帮你找老婆带孩子？”话说到一半，艾妮尔突然一闪，已经来到了多力的面前，只见挟持着多力的那个家伙手一紧，刀尖已经陷进了多力的皮肤。

    艾妮尔冷冷的一笑，“记住，别把人想的那么好，为了钱，他们什么都可以做，而我也是一样。”

    说完，艾妮尔不顾旁人诧异的目光，向门口走去。

    “Z……”多力被她说呆了，回过神来，对方已经走到门口，马上就要跨门而出。

    “对了，你也一样！”艾妮尔回头，带着浅浅的笑意，补充道。

    “哼！好！说的好！”正当艾妮尔回头跨门而出时，那个先前的年青吸血鬼放声笑道。

    艾妮尔没有理他，顾自跨出门去，感觉着月光如水般散到自己的身上，那种安心与平静，让她觉得这一刻是如此的美妙，如此的享受。

    可是此时却不是拿来随便享受的时间，所以她只是抬头看了一眼那如镜的明月，然后转身朝城门口走去，完全不顾四周围着她的贵族，一双双如血的眸子闪着冰冷的光芒。

    “等等！”突然，门内的那个年青贵族叫住了她。

    “还有什么事？不会要问我收食宿费吧？”艾妮尔停步，回身直视着对方，目光中平静的没有一点情感流露，任谁也猜不到她心里在想些什么，下一步会做些什么。

Page (1/3)

The power of gods is more often shown to humans. Without human eyes, they are like walking on human paths with broken wings.

The Angel of Light walked in front, and Enel followed behind. There were originally several angels behind them, but as they walked, none of them disappeared, and the Angel of Light continued to move forward as if they had not discovered anything. The speed was not fast, as if they were afraid that Enel would not be able to keep up. As for Enel, she had always looked absentminded since she started on the road, as if she had left her heart somewhere and did not bring it with her.

However, when they stood in front of the gate of the Vampire Villa, Enel suddenly stopped.

"What's wrong?" The light envoy stopped and turned around, looking directly at Enel behind him. At this last moment, he didn't want to fail, so he added a few more words, each sentence stimulating Enel, "Repent again? Want to find him? Get back into his arms? Become a hunter for the rest of your life?"

"No!" Enel shouted loudly. Each of these questions was painful in her heart. Of course, she had thought about it many times, but at this moment, these were not what she was thinking about.

"Then what are you thinking about? Why did you stop?" The title of the Messenger of Light does not shine in vain. If he did not have a certain ability to peep, how could so many people regard him as a god, worship him, let the angels call him the Messenger of Light, and obey his orders?

"..." As a result, Enel raised his head with a smile on his face, but this smile gave him a sense of familiarity, deja vu, "I'm thinking, even if I don't come back to Schirden, I don't have to go to some paradise with you!"

"You..." Guangming Zheng was surprised for the first time, because he didn't see the other person clearly. However, in this human world, are there any existences that he couldn't see clearly?Even if the opponent is a vampire, because in his opinion, the vampires are just some dirty humans with black blood, and there is nothing different in their souls.

"The human world is so big. Apart from Skeleton, there seems to be no need for me to go to the paradise I least want to go to, right?" Seeing the other party's surprise, Enel became more confident, because along the way, she had been thinking about a question, that is, without Thrall, would she really be nothing?Apart from being a hunter, she could no longer have another identity, except, of course, angels. The result was now. Seeing the Vampire Villa in front of her, she understood something. All along, from her birth until now, others have been in control of her own destiny, and now was the best time. She could finally throw off all the shackles, control her own destiny, and do something she wanted to do but had never been able to do, such as becoming a human and living a human life.

"What's your plan?" The Justice of Light readjusted his view of the female vampire in front of him and asked for her opinion. This was a change. As the Justice of Light, he was the most powerful existence among humans and even in heaven. The Justice of Light had never had the habit of asking other people's opinions, but today he changed it for a female noble. This seemed to indicate something invisibly, but he himself had not noticed it yet.

"I want to live here!" Enel raised her head and looked directly at the house sign in front of her head.

"Here? Vampire Villa?" When he mentioned the Vampire Villa, there was a strong sense of disdain in the tone of the Lord of Light.

"Yes!" Enel nodded in affirmation.

"But is there any difference between this place and heaven?" Zheng Guangming asked puzzledly. You must know that heaven is under the Vampire Villa, and the entrance is also within the Vampire Villa. In his opinion, the Vampire Villa is more often synonymous with heaven.
